Chapter 6735: Let Me Be Lazy

Chapter 6735: Let Me Be Lazy

Living beings fell to the ground, feeling as if they had just experienced a terrible nightmare. They didn’t remember what the nightmare was about; everything was a blur.

Overlords and immortals heaved a sigh of relief since they were next in line.

“That’s good, that’s good.” An immortal murmured.

For them, the appearance of the tribulation vessel was terrible news. However, both this vessel and the indescribable existence have disappeared. Hopefully, they have killed each other - this would be the perfect outcome.

“The vessel was incomplete, now it’s gone.” A shored immortal remarked.

Despite being incomplete, the vessel still overwhelmed the shadow. It had destroyed countless epochs in history, ending the lives of numerous immortals.

“Is it alive?” Primordial immortals wondered about the fate of the shadow. However, it was too dangerous to do so, as it was close to the high heaven.

“What a day, two let-go immortals and the tribulation vessel. What is going on with the world?” Another primordial immortal stood in a daze.

Primordial immortals ruled the three thousand worlds in Heaven Realm. Shored immortals rarely appeared in history. However, today marked the appearance of two monstrous cultivators. Next was the destroyer of history - the heaven’s avatar.

Meanwhile, Li Qiye’s body was still within the primordial source along with his new self. The old body was indestructible and everlasting, infinitely close to the high heaven.

This became quite a problem for Li Qiye since he didn’t want to repeat the high heaven’s mistake. He wanted to melt this body properly and return everything to the world, not leaving any future complications.

Therefore, this became his next task. Primordial light streams flowed through the tree and reached all worlds. They shined gently like fireflies, permeating every inch of soil.

Only the supreme existences could see the roots of the tree in their world.

“Sigh, can’t even let me be lazy?” Someone looked up at the sky and complained: “I’m not destined for labor...”

He looked ordinary but had a special smirk, revealing his optimistic nature. He held something wrapped in oilpaper, perhaps a salted duck egg purchased from the market.

“I live to be lazy, why must you do this to me?” He complained: “Suffer all you want but don’t drag me down with you, I’m happy just buying duck eggs and doing nothing. Bastard, you’re inhuman.”

He started crying: “Passing all the suffering to me when I just want to be carefree, bastard!”

Alas, Li Qiye didn’t hear him or care about the complaint.

He sat down helplessly and murmured: “I’ll get you back for this.”

With that, he unwrapped the oilpaper, revealing thirteen fate palaces!

He then moved them above his head and they became resplendent with a primordial light.

Laws from all the worlds gathered before him, twisting together to form the primordial will.

“Goddamn it, fuck!” He cursed and released his soul.

The will coiled and fused with his soul.

“Ahh!” He gave in to the process, creating a new true fate.

“Bastard, I’ll blow you to pieces if there’s a next time!” He shouted angrily before the formation of a new true fate surrounded by thirteen fate palaces.

He floated up into the air, hovering above the high heaven. Primordial light bloomed behind him and formed a primordial tree.

The primordial tree grew at a rapid rate so it became visible to worlds. As he hovered with his fate palaces, he surpassed all immortals.
